conbody.p: Before taking any actions, officers determine if the application is already under investigation for potential fraud. Officers can determine that there is an ongoing Integrity investigation for this application if:

ul.li: a 71 - Integrity Services case manual action (MA71) or 71 - Integrity Services case disentitlement (D71) is imposed;
an SROC created by Integrity is on file;
an Action Item (AI) WI is assigned to Integrity;
a Call Back (CB) WI is assigned to Integrity.

conbody.p: If none of these are on the file, officers review the file to determine if fraud indicators are present. If yes, officers:

ul.li: determine if the banking information has been changed in FTS and, if so, terminate the direct deposit;
impose a D71 on skeleton and BPNE 1, 2 or 7 claims or an MA71 on established claims, if necessary;
complete the registration number to suspend the initial application process to prevent the claim from establishing until an investigation is completed;
refer the issue to Integrity for investigation;

conbody.p: If the only fraud indicator is the fraud warning highlighted in red in FTS, the officers do not refer the issue to Integrity.

For more information, officers refer to Referral to Integrity: Temporary measures and fraudulent EI and EI ERB claims — Instructions . Referral to Integrity: Temporary measures and fraudulent EI and EI ERB claims — Instructions
